description: I am an 11th-standard student and aspiring aerospace engineer with strong analytical and investigative skills. I am competing solo to design a theoretical data-filtering model for the SPHEREx telescope.
summary: SPHEREx Spotter is a theoretical web app design that helps users find Planet 9 and brown dwarfs. It uses HEALPix tiling to handle massive telescope images without crashing browsers, the ZOGY algorithm to cleanly subtract background stars, and WebGPU for fast, real-time edge processing.
details: Our solution provides an architectural blueprint for a citizen science platform. It solves the problem of browser crashes from 72MB SPHEREx images by utilizing HEALPix and HiPS for spatial tiling. To eliminate false positives from background stars, it incorporates the ZOGY image differencing algorithm. Finally, it uses WebGPU to run AI object detection locally on the user's device, ensuring zero-latency performance without expensive cloud servers. I hold the NASA Open Science Essentials certificate and am currently completing the full 101 curriculum. This platform is designedaround NASA's open science principles.
